name: gptpro
description: Desktop-only ChatGPT Pro repository collaboration with a read-only MCP companion.

interface.shortDescription: Desktop ChatGPT Pro with read-only repository context
interface.longDescription: For an explicitly requested repository consultation, use the visible ChatGPT macOS app together with the exact installed gptpro-mcp companion and Secure MCP Tunnel. Prepare an immutable Schema 4 package, enforce secret scanning and approval, send at most once from an empty new general Chat through visible Desktop UI, expose only bounded read-only repository tools, collect the matching response, and independently validate all advice. Browser delivery, CDP, Electron-private APIs, local writes, shell commands, and automatic resend are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Use $gptpro to prepare a bounded Desktop Pro review with read-only repository access.
Use $gptpro to submit one approved prompt through the visible ChatGPT macOS app and never resend.
Use $gptpro to independently validate ChatGPT Pro advice before applying it.
